ChatGPT Dots vs Meta Muse which personal AI agent is actually better? I used both AI assistants for several weeks and tested them on two very different real-world jobs: planning my daughter’s birthday party and managing development for my Ango Tasks app.

In this hands-on comparison, I look at pricing, ease of use, proactive task handling, Notion and Gmail integrations, ChatGPT Work, Codex, computer use, reasoning ability, and more.

Claude Duet vs ChatGPT Dots vs GrokBot
Grok Bot, Muse, Dots, and now Claude Duet. In 10 weeks, 4 of the biggest AI companies dropped an always-on agent. They all do the same basic thing, so I skipped the obvious and went straight to what's different: 8 categories, a winner for each, and a final leaderboard. At the end, a free skill that puts the best feature of all 3 inside Claude Code 👇

🎁 Get Show It Once (and all my other skills) free in my Skool: https://www.skool.com/nextphase-5790
🤝 Stuck installing? We run weekly calls in the Skool to help you.

⚠️ Duet is on a waitlist and I don't have access yet, so everything on Duet comes from what Anthropic published, not my own test. Not sponsored.

🏆 The 8 categories
1. Price: Duet. Included in Claude Pro ($20/month). Grok Bot starts at $30 (Premium on The X Subscription), Dots at ChatGPT Pro ($100). Catch: Duet is waitlist only, and Grok Bot is the only one where I found a free trial.
2. Usage: Dots. Talking to your dot doesn't count toward your ChatGPT limits, and in its first month Dots usage doesn't count at all. Duet shares your Claude limits and checks your apps every few hours to save them. Grok Bot's weekly allowance is shared with Grok and Cursor, the number isn't published, and people say it runs out fast.
3. Who can use it today: Grok Bot. No waitlist, no country block I could find. Dots on Pro isn't in the EU, UK or Switzerland (you need Business with a Premium seat). Duet: US only, Pro and Max, waitlist.
4. Number of agents: Grok Bot. 50+ bots in group chats that hand work off. Dots and Duet: 1 each, for now.
5. Apps: Duet, on paper. 6,000+ connectors and plugins, and it can buy things with a virtual card. Dots: 4,000+. Grok Bot: no number, but it uses the computer when there's no connector.
6. Your work day: Dots. Slack, Teams, @dot in comments, you can call it, and it starts work in Codex. Grok Bot lives on X with its own email per bot. Duet lives in its own app.
7. Safety: Duet, on paper. It never sees your passwords, blocks sharing card numbers and IDs, and some things (trading stocks, moving money) are off-limits even with your approval. Dots is close: auto-review, Custom Rules, Activity View. Grok Bot checks before anything it can't undo, but the full action log is Enterprise only.
8. Learning by watching: Grok Bot, the only one. Record a task (up to 10 min) and it turns it into a skill. Dots and Duet can't do that.

Bonus: Duet runs on Opus 5.5, Dots on GPT-6 Astra. Grok Bot has no model picker, and its help page mentions Opus 5.5. So sometimes your Grok Bot is running on Claude.

Grok Bot: 3 wins (access, agents, learning by watching)
Duet: 3 wins (price, apps, safety), all on paper
Dots: 2 wins (usage, work day)
Want one today? Grok Bot. Team on Slack or Teams with Pro? Your dot. In the US on Claude Pro or Max? Join the Duet waitlist.

OpenAI Dots Tutorial: Put Your AI Agent On Call in 4 Steps
When something breaks in your business at 3 a.m., OpenAI's Dots can now be the first one on it. You wake up to a message that already says what broke, when it started, the likely cause, and a draft of what to do next.

In this video:
- Step 1: give your Dot a seat in Slack (and the gotcha: added is not watching)
- Step 2: put every alarm into one channel (payments, site down, bookings, urgent forms)
- Step 3: the exact prompt I'd use, and why each part matters
- Step 4: guardrails: draft is not send, custom rules, what you get for free
- A full 3 a.m. walkthrough, plus the engineer version from OpenAI's demo (phone to laptop)
- The honest limits

Good to know (from OpenAI's docs):
- Dots are rolling out gradually on Pro, Business Premium and Enterprise. Pro isn't available in the EEA, UK or Switzerland. On Enterprise, an admin turns it on.
- Adding your Dot to a channel doesn't start monitoring. Tell it what to watch, and ask it to confirm.
- Talking to your Dot doesn't count against your ChatGPT limits. Work it hands to Codex or ChatGPT Work does.
- Review the output, even after a run completes.

The screens in this video are rebuilt from OpenAI's demo and documentation, so yours may look a little different. The engineer workflow is from OpenAI's video "Put your dot on call."

ms.summary: Beri Dot tempat dalam Slack, salurkan semua amaran ke satu saluran, guna prompt berstruktur dan tambah pagar seperti draf sahaja tanpa hantar. Video menegaskan menambah Dot ke saluran tidak memulakan pemantauan; beritahu apa yang perlu dipantau dan minta pengesahan.

vi.title: Hướng dẫn OpenAI Dots: cho agent trực ca trong 4 bước
vi.summary: Cho Dot một chỗ trong Slack, dồn mọi cảnh báo vào một kênh, viết prompt có cấu trúc và đặt rào chắn như chỉ soạn nháp, không gửi. Video nhấn mạnh thêm Dot vào kênh không có nghĩa nó bắt đầu theo dõi; hãy nói rõ cần theo dõi gì và yêu cầu nó xác nhận.

fr.title: Tutoriel OpenAI Dots : mettre votre agent d'astreinte en 4 étapes
fr.summary: Donnez une place Slack à votre Dot, regroupez toutes les alertes dans un canal, utilisez un prompt structuré et ajoutez des garde-fous comme brouillon sans envoi. La vidéo insiste : ajouter un Dot à un canal ne lance pas la surveillance, il faut lui dire quoi suivre et lui demander de confirmer.

es.title: Tutorial de OpenAI Dots: pon a tu agente de guardia en 4 pasos
es.summary: Dale a tu Dot un sitio en Slack, envía todas las alertas a un canal, usa un prompt estructurado y añade límites como solo borrador, sin enviar. El video recalca que añadir el Dot a un canal no inicia la vigilancia: dile qué vigilar y pídele que lo confirme.

de.title: OpenAI-Dots-Tutorial: Agent in 4 Schritten in Rufbereitschaft
de.summary: Dem Dot einen Slack-Platz geben, alle Alarme in einen Kanal leiten, einen strukturierten Prompt nutzen und Leitplanken wie Entwurf statt Senden setzen. Das Video betont: Hinzufügen zum Kanal startet keine Überwachung; sag ihm, was es beobachten soll, und lass es bestätigen.

items.author: Grok
items.text:
Grok Bot 201
In this workshop, Joseph Yang, Senior Field Engineer, and Scott Lerner, Senior AI Deployment Manager at SpaceXAI, show how to move from a single bot to a team of bots that work on their own.

Key topics covered:
• Bots that run on their own: Set up a skill and a routine so a bot runs a workflow every 24 hours without a prompt.
• Team bots: Share a bot with your team, and put bots and people in the same group chat.
• Specialized roles: Give each bot one job with its own memory and context, the way you'd staff a startup team.
• Fan-out with Cursor Cloud Agents: Ask Grok Bot to launch Cursor Cloud Agents on three models with one prompt, then combine the best ideas from each design.
• A self-evolving website: Watch an orchestrator bot pull Vercel analytics from a metrics bot, ask a designer bot for new stickers, and have a developer bot swap them into the site.
• Voice and email: Talk to your bots by voice or dictation, and ask your bot to claim its own email address.

Timestamps:
• 0:00 Welcome and introductions
• 0:46 Tour of the Grok Bot interface
• 4:40 Recap of Grok Bot 101
• 6:40 Team bots and group chats
• 13:58 Building the Sticker Shop with a UI/UX designer bot
• 15:34 Fanning out Cursor Cloud Agents across three models
• 22:38 Brainstorming the stack by voice with a full stack bot
• 29:21 Comparing the fan-out results
• 33:07 The AI maturity curve
• 35:01 Meet Ed, the metrics bot
• 37:38 Roy orchestrates a self-evolving sticker shop
• 52:06 Q&A: Fan-out and token efficiency

Helpful resources:
• Team Bots docs: https://docs.x.ai/grok-bot/team-bots
• Skills and routines docs: https://docs.x.ai/grok-bot/skills-routines-and-automations
• Cursor Cloud Agents docs: https://cursor.com/docs/cloud-agent

This is a recording from our live session on October 9, 2026.

For more events like this, check out upcoming workshops at https://cursor.com/workshops

zh-CN.title: Grok Bot 201：从单个 Bot 到自主运行的 Bot 团队
zh-CN.summary: 官方工作坊：用 skill 加 routine 让 Bot 每 24 小时自动跑流程；把 Bot 分享给团队并和人同在群聊；每个 Bot 一个职责；用一条提示词在三个模型上分发 Cursor Cloud Agents；演示编排 Bot 根据 Vercel 数据让设计和开发 Bot 更新网站。

zh-TW.title: Grok Bot 201：從單一 Bot 到自主運作的 Bot 團隊
zh-TW.summary: 官方工作坊：用 skill 加 routine 讓 Bot 每 24 小時自動跑流程；把 Bot 分享給團隊並與人同在群組聊天；每個 Bot 一個職責；用一則提示詞在三個模型上分派 Cursor Cloud Agents；示範編排 Bot 依 Vercel 數據讓設計與開發 Bot 更新網站。

en.title: Grok Bot 201: from one bot to a team that runs on its own
en.summary: Official workshop: a skill plus a routine runs a workflow every 24 hours without a prompt; share bots with your team in group chats; give each bot one role; fan out Cursor Cloud Agents across three models with one prompt; and watch an orchestrator bot use Vercel analytics to have designer and developer bots update a site.

ja.title: Grok Bot 201：1 体の Bot から自走するチームへ
ja.summary: 公式ワークショップ。skill と routine で Bot が 24 時間ごとにプロンプトなしでワークフローを実行、Bot をチームと共有しグループチャットで人と一緒に使う、Bot ごとに役割を 1 つ、1 つのプロンプトで 3 モデルに Cursor Cloud Agents を展開、統括 Bot が Vercel の分析をもとにデザイナー Bot と開発 Bot にサイトを更新させるデモ。

ko.title: Grok Bot 201: 봇 하나에서 스스로 움직이는 팀으로
ko.summary: 공식 워크숍입니다. skill과 routine으로 봇이 24시간마다 프롬프트 없이 워크플로를 실행하고, 봇을 팀과 공유해 그룹 채팅에서 사람과 함께 쓰며, 봇마다 역할을 하나씩 줍니다. 프롬프트 하나로 세 모델에 Cursor Cloud Agents를 펼치고, 오케스트레이터 봇이 Vercel 분석으로 디자이너·개발자 봇에게 사이트를 업데이트하게 하는 데모가 나옵니다.

ms.title: Grok Bot 201: daripada satu bot kepada pasukan yang bergerak sendiri
ms.summary: Bengkel rasmi: skill dan routine menjalankan aliran kerja setiap 24 jam tanpa prompt; kongsi bot dengan pasukan dalam sembang kumpulan; beri setiap bot satu peranan; sebar Cursor Cloud Agents ke tiga model dengan satu prompt; dan bot pengatur guna analitik Vercel supaya bot pereka dan pembangun mengemas kini laman.

vi.title: Grok Bot 201: từ một bot đến một đội tự vận hành
vi.summary: Workshop chính thức: skill cộng routine chạy quy trình mỗi 24 giờ không cần prompt; chia sẻ bot với nhóm trong group chat; mỗi bot một vai trò; dùng một prompt để tỏa Cursor Cloud Agents trên ba mô hình; và bot điều phối dùng số liệu Vercel để bot thiết kế và bot lập trình cập nhật trang web.

fr.title: Grok Bot 201 : d'un bot à une équipe autonome
fr.summary: Atelier officiel : un skill et une routine lancent un workflow toutes les 24 h sans prompt ; partage des bots en discussion de groupe ; un rôle par bot ; déploiement de Cursor Cloud Agents sur trois modèles en un prompt ; et un bot orchestrateur qui utilise les stats Vercel pour faire mettre à jour un site par des bots designer et développeur.

es.title: Grok Bot 201: de un bot a un equipo que trabaja solo
es.summary: Taller oficial: un skill y una routine ejecutan un flujo cada 24 horas sin prompt; comparte bots con tu equipo en chats grupales; un rol por bot; reparte Cursor Cloud Agents en tres modelos con un prompt; y un bot orquestador usa analíticas de Vercel para que bots de diseño y desarrollo actualicen un sitio.

de.title: Grok Bot 201: vom einzelnen Bot zum selbstständigen Team
de.summary: Offizieller Workshop: Skill plus Routine startet alle 24 Stunden einen Workflow ohne Prompt; Bots im Team in Gruppenchats teilen; eine Rolle pro Bot; Cursor Cloud Agents mit einem Prompt auf drei Modelle verteilen; ein Orchestrator-Bot lässt anhand von Vercel-Analytics Designer- und Entwickler-Bots eine Seite aktualisieren.

items.author: kazz_ai_job
items.text:
会社員ですが、Claude CodeとGrok Botを使い分けて3ヵ月で100件超の仕事をAIに任せてきました。

Claude Codeには、分析、資料作り、毎週のルーティン業務。
Grok Botには、毎朝のリサーチ、スケジュール管理

どちらも、「仕組み」を作るのが大事でした。

・指示書は「場面ごとの参照表」だけにして、詳細は別ファイルへ
・記憶の置き場所は1か所にまとめる
・チームのナレッジ化
・役割は1つのAIに1つずつ

こういう仕組みを具体的に出していきます！

zh-CN.title: 上班族 3 个月把 100 多件工作交给 Claude Code 和 Grok Bot
zh-CN.summary: 作者把分析、做资料和每周例行工作交给 Claude Code，把每天早上的调研和日程管理交给 Grok Bot。经验：指令书只放场景对照表、细节另存文件；记忆集中一处；团队知识化；一个 AI 只担一个角色。

zh-TW.title: 上班族 3 個月把 100 多件工作交給 Claude Code 與 Grok Bot
zh-TW.summary: 作者把分析、做資料與每週例行工作交給 Claude Code，把每天早上的研究與行程管理交給 Grok Bot。經驗：指令書只放情境對照表、細節另存檔案；記憶集中一處；團隊知識化；一個 AI 只擔一個角色。

en.title: An office worker handed 100+ tasks to Claude Code and Grok Bot in 3 months
en.summary: Claude Code takes analysis, documents and weekly routine work; Grok Bot handles morning research and schedule management. Their rules: keep instructions to a per-situation lookup table with details in separate files, keep memory in one place, turn it into team knowledge, and give each AI one role.

ja.title: 会社員が 3 か月で 100 件超の仕事を Claude Code と Grok Bot に任せた
ja.summary: 分析・資料作り・毎週のルーティンは Claude Code、毎朝のリサーチとスケジュール管理は Grok Bot。仕組みとして、指示書は場面ごとの参照表だけにして詳細は別ファイルへ、記憶の置き場所は 1 か所、チームのナレッジ化、役割は 1 つの AI に 1 つ。

ko.title: 회사원이 3개월간 100건 넘는 업무를 Claude Code와 Grok Bot에 맡긴 방법
ko.summary: 분석, 자료 작성, 주간 루틴은 Claude Code가, 매일 아침 리서치와 일정 관리는 Grok Bot이 맡습니다. 규칙은 지시서를 상황별 참조표로만 두고 세부 내용은 별도 파일로, 기억은 한곳에, 팀 지식화, AI 하나에 역할 하나입니다.

ms.title: Pekerja pejabat serahkan 100+ tugas kepada Claude Code dan Grok Bot dalam 3 bulan
ms.summary: Claude Code untuk analisis, dokumen dan kerja rutin mingguan; Grok Bot untuk penyelidikan pagi dan urusan jadual. Peraturannya: arahan hanya jadual rujukan ikut situasi dengan butiran dalam fail lain, memori di satu tempat, jadikan pengetahuan pasukan, dan satu peranan untuk setiap AI.

vi.title: Nhân viên văn phòng giao hơn 100 việc cho Claude Code và Grok Bot trong 3 tháng
vi.summary: Claude Code lo phân tích, làm tài liệu và việc định kỳ hằng tuần; Grok Bot lo nghiên cứu mỗi sáng và quản lý lịch. Nguyên tắc: bản chỉ dẫn chỉ là bảng tra theo tình huống, chi tiết để file riêng; bộ nhớ gom một chỗ; biến thành tri thức chung của nhóm; mỗi AI một vai trò.

fr.title: Un salarié a confié plus de 100 tâches à Claude Code et Grok Bot en 3 mois
fr.summary: Claude Code gère analyses, documents et tâches hebdomadaires ; Grok Bot la veille du matin et l'agenda. Ses règles : des consignes réduites à une table par situation avec les détails ailleurs, une mémoire au même endroit, un savoir partagé d'équipe, et un seul rôle par IA.

es.title: Un oficinista delegó más de 100 tareas en Claude Code y Grok Bot en 3 meses
es.summary: Claude Code se encarga de análisis, documentos y rutinas semanales; Grok Bot de la investigación matutina y la agenda. Sus reglas: instrucciones como tabla de consulta por situación con detalles aparte, memoria en un solo lugar, conocimiento compartido del equipo y un rol por IA.

de.title: Ein Angestellter gab in 3 Monaten über 100 Aufgaben an Claude Code und Grok Bot ab
de.summary: Claude Code übernimmt Analysen, Unterlagen und wöchentliche Routinen, Grok Bot die Morgenrecherche und Terminplanung. Seine Regeln: Anweisungen nur als Nachschlagetabelle pro Situation, Details in separaten Dateien, Gedächtnis an einem Ort, Teamwissen aufbauen, eine Rolle pro KI.

items.author: PS_Halawa
items.text:
What a time to be alive
I asked @grok Bot to order me some clothes from a @WooCommerce staging store I set up, and to record the whole thing.

It browsed, picked a full set, checked out, and paid with a test card. Then it edited the recording into a ready-to-publish demo video. (and it actually looks good!)

zh-CN.title: 让 Grok Bot 在测试商店下单并剪成演示视频
zh-CN.summary: 作者让 Grok Bot 在自己搭的 WooCommerce 测试商店买衣服并全程录屏。它浏览、选好整套、结账并用测试卡付款，然后把录屏剪成可直接发布的演示视频。

zh-TW.title: 讓 Grok Bot 在測試商店下單並剪成示範影片
zh-TW.summary: 作者讓 Grok Bot 在自己架的 WooCommerce 測試商店買衣服並全程錄影。它瀏覽、挑好整套、結帳並用測試卡付款，再把錄影剪成可直接發布的示範影片。

en.title: Grok Bot shops a test store and edits the demo video
en.summary: The author asked Grok Bot to order clothes from a WooCommerce staging store and record it. It browsed, picked a full set, checked out and paid with a test card, then edited the recording into a ready-to-publish demo video.

ja.title: Grok Bot がテストストアで買い物し、デモ動画まで編集
ja.summary: 自作の WooCommerce ステージングストアで服を注文し録画するよう依頼。Grok Bot は閲覧してコーディネート一式を選び、テストカードで決済し、録画を公開できるデモ動画に編集した。

ko.title: Grok Bot이 테스트 스토어에서 쇼핑하고 데모 영상까지 편집
ko.summary: 작성자는 직접 만든 WooCommerce 스테이징 스토어에서 옷을 주문하고 녹화하라고 했습니다. Grok Bot은 둘러보고 한 벌을 고른 뒤 테스트 카드로 결제했고, 녹화본을 바로 게시할 수 있는 데모 영상으로 편집했습니다.

ms.title: Grok Bot membeli-belah di kedai ujian dan menyunting video demo
ms.summary: Penulis meminta Grok Bot memesan pakaian dari kedai staging WooCommerce dan merakamnya. Ia melayari, memilih satu set penuh, membuat pembayaran dengan kad ujian, lalu menyunting rakaman menjadi video demo sedia terbit.

vi.title: Grok Bot mua sắm ở cửa hàng thử và dựng luôn video demo
vi.summary: Tác giả nhờ Grok Bot đặt quần áo từ cửa hàng staging WooCommerce và quay lại toàn bộ. Nó duyệt, chọn cả bộ, thanh toán bằng thẻ thử, rồi dựng bản ghi thành video demo sẵn để đăng.

fr.title: Grok Bot fait ses achats sur une boutique test et monte la vidéo
fr.summary: L'auteur a demandé à Grok Bot de commander des vêtements sur une boutique WooCommerce de test et de tout enregistrer. Il a navigué, choisi une tenue complète, payé avec une carte de test, puis monté l'enregistrement en vidéo de démo prête à publier.

es.title: Grok Bot compra en una tienda de prueba y edita el video demo
es.summary: El autor pidió a Grok Bot comprar ropa en una tienda WooCommerce de staging y grabarlo. Navegó, eligió un conjunto completo, pagó con una tarjeta de prueba y editó la grabación en un video demo listo para publicar.

de.title: Grok Bot kauft im Testshop ein und schneidet das Demovideo
de.summary: Der Autor ließ Grok Bot in einem WooCommerce-Staging-Shop Kleidung bestellen und alles aufzeichnen. Es stöberte, wählte ein komplettes Outfit, zahlte mit einer Testkarte und schnitt die Aufnahme zu einem veröffentlichungsfertigen Demovideo.

items.author: kamilbanc
items.text:

We got into how he built it with Grok Bot, a privacy scare and what still needs fixing.

Full interview below. My notes and case study: https://t.co/ueXhQlKpHt https://t.co/YpGVtxnFWA

zh-CN.title: Beardbrand 用 Grok Bot 恢复电话客服
zh-CN.summary: 访谈 Beardbrand 的 bandholz：他如何用 Grok Bot 做 AI 电话客服、遇到的一次隐私惊吓，以及还需要修的地方。作者另附笔记和案例。

zh-TW.title: Beardbrand 用 Grok Bot 恢復電話客服
zh-TW.summary: 訪談 Beardbrand 的 bandholz：他如何用 Grok Bot 做 AI 電話客服、遇到的一次隱私驚嚇，以及還需要修正的地方。作者另附筆記與案例。

en.title: Beardbrand brings phone support back with Grok Bot
en.summary: An interview with bandholz on how he built AI phone support for Beardbrand with Grok Bot, a privacy scare along the way, and what still needs fixing. Notes and a case study are linked.

ja.title: Beardbrand が Grok Bot で電話サポートを復活
ja.summary: Beardbrand の bandholz へのインタビュー。Grok Bot で AI 電話サポートを作った方法、途中のプライバシー上のヒヤリ、まだ直すべき点を語る。メモとケーススタディのリンク付き。

ko.title: Beardbrand, Grok Bot으로 전화 고객지원 부활
ko.summary: Beardbrand의 bandholz 인터뷰로, Grok Bot으로 AI 전화 지원을 만든 방법, 도중에 겪은 개인정보 관련 위기, 아직 고칠 점을 다룹니다. 메모와 사례 연구 링크가 있습니다.

ms.title: Beardbrand kembalikan sokongan telefon dengan Grok Bot
ms.summary: Temu bual bersama bandholz tentang cara dia membina sokongan telefon AI untuk Beardbrand dengan Grok Bot, satu kejutan privasi, dan apa yang masih perlu dibaiki. Nota dan kajian kes dipautkan.

vi.title: Beardbrand đưa hỗ trợ qua điện thoại trở lại nhờ Grok Bot
vi.summary: Phỏng vấn bandholz về cách dựng hỗ trợ điện thoại bằng AI cho Beardbrand với Grok Bot, một lần hú vía về quyền riêng tư và những gì còn phải sửa. Có link ghi chú và case study.

fr.title: Beardbrand relance son support téléphonique avec Grok Bot
fr.summary: Entretien avec bandholz sur la mise en place d'un support téléphonique IA chez Beardbrand avec Grok Bot, une frayeur liée à la vie privée et ce qu'il reste à corriger. Notes et étude de cas en lien.

es.title: Beardbrand recupera la atención telefónica con Grok Bot
es.summary: Entrevista a bandholz sobre cómo montó atención telefónica con IA para Beardbrand usando Grok Bot, un susto de privacidad y lo que aún falta arreglar. Incluye notas y un caso de estudio.

de.title: Beardbrand bringt Telefonsupport mit Grok Bot zurück
de.summary: Interview mit bandholz darüber, wie er mit Grok Bot KI-Telefonsupport für Beardbrand aufgebaut hat, über einen Datenschutz-Schreck und was noch zu reparieren ist. Notizen und Fallstudie verlinkt.

items.author: sorcererxw
items.text:
Hey @poteto I'm on the X Ultra plan and use it only for Grok @bot , and I still burn through it way too fast. It's nowhere near enough.

I run a dozen bots with routines, and I can't see which one is eating the usage.

Please add token usage per bot and per routine (by day would

zh-CN.title: 跑十几个带 routine 的 Bot，X Ultra 额度仍不够用
zh-CN.summary: 作者只用 X Ultra 方案跑 Grok Bot，十几个 Bot 都设了 routine，额度仍消耗太快，且看不出哪个在耗用量，请求按 Bot 和按 routine 显示 token 用量。

zh-TW.title: 跑十幾個帶 routine 的 Bot，X Ultra 額度仍不夠用
zh-TW.summary: 作者只用 X Ultra 方案跑 Grok Bot，十幾個 Bot 都設了 routine，額度仍消耗太快，也看不出是哪個在吃用量，請求依 Bot 與 routine 顯示 token 用量。

en.title: A dozen bots with routines still burn through X Ultra
en.summary: The author uses the X Ultra plan only for Grok Bot and runs a dozen bots with routines, yet the allowance runs out too fast and there's no way to see which bot uses it. They ask for token usage per bot and per routine.

ja.title: routine 付き Bot を十数体動かすと X Ultra でも足りない
ja.summary: X Ultra プランを Grok Bot だけに使い、routine 付きの Bot を十数体運用しているが枠の消費が速すぎ、どの Bot が使っているか見えない。Bot ごと・routine ごとのトークン使用量表示を要望。

items.author: MaiYangAI
items.text:
Peter Yang 实测 Claude Duet：我还是更喜欢 Grok Bot

Anthropic 刚放出个人 agent Claude Duet 的研究预览，Peter Yang 拿到了抢先体验，这期把它从头到尾用了一遍。他做 Behind the Craft，日历排满播客录制和赞助通话，newsletter 的客服也是他自己带着 AI agent 在做，算是很典型的重度用户。

他说 Duet 是他用过最主动的个人 agent。原因很简单，它默认带一个 Check-in 定时任务，从早上 9 点到晚上 10 点每三小时跑一次。他觉得它是在翻邮箱和日历，找能替他做的活。他也直说一天五次有点多。

视频大半在演示 artifact。晨间简报、每日待办、邮件分拣、YouTube 频道分析报告、赞助收入看板，还有给孩子学 AI 的探索俱乐部。为了让它替自己回邮件，他先跑了 learn-how-i-write，Duet 读了他 33 封邮件、89 条 Slack 消息、47 条私信和 11 份文档，写出一份他的写作风格指南。

短板他也讲了。让 Duet 叫 Uber 没办成，卡在要人来过的验证上，可 App 里看不到也碰不到它的浏览器。他本地的个人 skill 好像也加不进来。

最后他把 Duet 和 Grok Bot、Muse、ChatGPT Dots 摆在一起比。他说 Grok Bot 仍是他目前最爱的 agent，免费的 X 集成很适合做市场调研，缺点是邮件还不太好用。说到 Claude，他说现在 Claude 是他主力的 harness 和模型，Duet 是 Anthropic 个人 agent 很棒的开局，他很期待后面的改进。

vi.title: Peter Yang thử Claude Duet nhưng vẫn thích Grok Bot hơn
vi.summary: Check-in mặc định của Duet chạy ba giờ một lần từ 9 giờ đến 22 giờ, anh thấy hơi nhiều. Anh demo bản tin sáng, phân loại email, báo cáo YouTube, bảng tài trợ, và cho Duet đọc 33 email cùng nhiều tin nhắn để viết hướng dẫn văn phong. Gọi Uber bị kẹt ở bước xác minh. Grok Bot vẫn là yêu thích nhờ tích hợp X để nghiên cứu thị trường, dù email còn yếu.

fr.title: Peter Yang teste Claude Duet et préfère toujours Grok Bot
fr.summary: Le check-in par défaut de Duet tourne toutes les trois heures de 9 h à 22 h, un peu trop selon lui. Il montre brief du matin, tri des e-mails, rapport YouTube et tableau des sponsors, et fait lire 33 e-mails et plus à Duet pour écrire un guide de style. Commander un Uber a bloqué sur une vérification. Grok Bot reste son préféré pour la veille via X, même si l'e-mail est faible.

es.title: Peter Yang prueba Claude Duet y sigue prefiriendo Grok Bot
es.summary: El check-in por defecto de Duet corre cada tres horas de 9 a 22 h, algo excesivo para él. Muestra resumen matinal, clasificación de correo, informe de YouTube y panel de patrocinios, y hace que Duet lea 33 correos y más para redactar una guía de estilo. Pedir un Uber se atascó en una verificación. Grok Bot sigue siendo su favorito para investigar mercado con X, aunque flojea en correo.

Er zeigt Morgenbriefing, Mail-Triage, YouTube-Report und Sponsoren-Dashboard und lässt Duet 33 Mails und mehr lesen, um einen Stilguide zu schreiben. Eine Uber-Bestellung scheiterte an einer Verifizierung. Grok Bot bleibt sein Favorit für Marktrecherche über X, auch wenn E-Mail schwächelt.

items.author: rumanagarwal
items.text:
Three days in, one of my bots refused another bot's word that I'd approved something: "I need to hear it from you here."

That's when I noticed how much my Grok Bot use has changed. Day one was "connect this". Today it's mostly "go".

Grok Bot plans, Claude Code does the work. My CX bot reviews a backlog, commits a handoff file to my shared repo and messages Claude Remote, which runs Claude Code on my Mac. The results come back to the CX bot. 4 rounds today. Claude Remote wanted my yes in its own chat, not passed along by another bot. So I say yes twice, and I'm fine with that.

What else changed:
• Tiers instead of item by item. My CX bot sorts work into "go", "check and go" and "needs a plan", so I approve a batch in one word.
• Schedules over chat. This was the biggest win as my chief of staff sends an attention list every hour, 9am to 9pm: what needs me across Slack, email and calendar. I tried it for one afternoon and asked for it again the next day. It skips the hour when nothing is new.
• Bots setting up bots. One bot spun up my data analyst with a rule I'd told it that morning already built in.
• One shared changelog. Grok Bot and Claude Code both write to it. When I asked if everything was logged, the CX bot audited itself and found 2 gaps.

I've stopped asking my bots for things. Mostly I approve what they've already lined up.

zh-CN.summary: 作者的客服 Bot 审积压、把交接文件提交到共享仓库，再通知在 Mac 上跑 Claude Code 的 Claude Remote，结果回传，当天跑了 4 轮。工作按三档分级，一个词批准一批；幕僚长 Bot 9 点到 21 点每小时发待处理清单，没新内容就跳过；两边写同一份更新日志，自查发现 2 处缺漏。

en.title: Three days in: Grok Bot plans, Claude Code does the work
en.summary: The author's CX bot reviews a backlog, commits a handoff file to a shared repo and messages Claude Remote, which runs Claude Code on their Mac; results return, 4 rounds that day. Work is sorted into three tiers for one-word batch approval, a chief-of-staff bot sends an hourly attention list from 9am to 9pm and skips quiet hours, and both tools write one changelog, where a self-audit found 2 gaps.

ko.title: 3일째: 계획은 Grok Bot, 실행은 Claude Code

Kerja disusun dalam tiga peringkat untuk kelulusan berkelompok satu perkataan, bot ketua staf menghantar senarai perhatian setiap jam dari 9 pagi hingga 9 malam dan melangkau jika tiada yang baharu, dan kedua-dua alat menulis satu log perubahan; audit sendiri menemui 2 jurang.

vi.title: Ngày thứ ba: Grok Bot lên kế hoạch, Claude Code làm việc

Việc chia ba cấp để duyệt cả lô bằng một từ, bot chánh văn phòng gửi danh sách cần chú ý mỗi giờ từ 9 đến 21 giờ và bỏ qua khi không có gì mới, hai công cụ ghi chung một changelog, tự kiểm tra thấy 2 chỗ thiếu.

fr.title: Au bout de trois jours : Grok Bot planifie, Claude Code exécute
fr.summary: Le bot CX de l'auteur passe en revue un backlog, commite un fichier de passation dans un dépôt partagé et écrit à Claude Remote, qui lance Claude Code sur son Mac ; les résultats reviennent, 4 allers-retours ce jour-là. Le travail est trié en trois niveaux pour une validation groupée en un mot, un bot chef de cabinet envoie chaque heure de 9 h à 21 h une liste des points à voir et saute les heures calmes, et les deux outils écrivent un même changelog, où un auto-audit a trouvé 2 manques.

es.summary: El bot de CX del autor revisa un backlog, sube un archivo de traspaso a un repositorio compartido y avisa a Claude Remote, que ejecuta Claude Code en su Mac; los resultados vuelven, 4 rondas ese día. El trabajo se clasifica en tres niveles para aprobar lotes con una palabra, un bot jefe de gabinete envía cada hora de 9 a 21 h una lista de pendientes y se salta las horas sin novedades, y ambas herramientas escriben un mismo changelog, donde una autoauditoría halló 2 huecos.

de.title: Nach drei Tagen: Grok Bot plant, Claude Code arbeitet
de.summary: Der CX-Bot des Autors sichtet einen Backlog, committet eine Übergabedatei in ein gemeinsames Repo und schreibt Claude Remote, das Claude Code auf dem Mac ausführt; Ergebnisse kommen zurück, 4 Runden an dem Tag. Arbeit wird in drei Stufen sortiert und mit einem Wort gesammelt freigegeben, ein Stabschef-Bot schickt von 9 bis 21 Uhr stündlich eine Aufmerksamkeitsliste und überspringt ruhige Stunden, und beide Tools schreiben ein gemeinsames Changelog, in dem ein Selbstaudit 2 Lücken fand.

ja.summary: 毎朝 5 時の 1 日の計画、毎晩の支出チェック、寝る前のリマインド、日曜の週次レビュー、自分の条件に沿った毎日の求人探し、受信箱の要約。承認なしには何も送らない。

ko.title: 쉬는 날 Grok Bot으로 만든 개인 비서
ko.summary: 작성자의 비서는 매일 새벽 5시 하루 계획, 매일 밤 지출 점검, 취침 알림, 일요일 주간 리뷰, 자신의 조건에 맞춘 매일 구직 검색, 받은편지함 요약을 하며 승인 없이는 아무것도 보내지 않습니다.

ms.title: Pembantu peribadi hari cuti dibina di Grok Bot
ms.summary: Pembantu penulis menyediakan pelan hari pada 5 pagi, semakan perbelanjaan setiap malam, peringatan sebelum tidur, ulasan minggu pada hari Ahad, carian kerja harian ikut penapisnya sendiri, dan ringkasan peti masuk, tanpa menghantar apa-apa tanpa kebenaran.

vi.title: Trợ lý cá nhân dựng trên Grok Bot trong ngày nghỉ
vi.summary: Trợ lý của tác giả lập kế hoạch lúc 5 giờ sáng, kiểm tra chi tiêu mỗi tối, nhắc đi ngủ, tổng kết tuần vào Chủ nhật, tìm việc mỗi ngày theo bộ lọc riêng và tóm tắt hộp thư, không gửi gì khi chưa được đồng ý.

fr.title: Un assistant personnel monté sur Grok Bot un jour de congé
fr.summary: L'assistant de l'auteur prépare un plan de journée à 5 h, vérifie les dépenses chaque soir, rappelle l'heure du coucher, fait un bilan le dimanche, cherche des emplois chaque jour selon ses filtres et résume la boîte mail, sans rien envoyer sans accord.

es.title: Un asistente personal hecho en Grok Bot en un día libre
es.summary: El asistente del autor prepara un plan a las 5 de la mañana, revisa gastos cada noche, recuerda irse a dormir, hace un repaso semanal el domingo, busca empleo a diario con sus filtros y resume la bandeja de entrada, sin enviar nada sin su visto bueno.

de.title: Ein persönlicher Assistent auf Grok Bot, gebaut am freien Tag
de.summary: Der Assistent des Autors liefert um 5 Uhr einen Tagesplan, prüft abends die Ausgaben, erinnert ans Schlafengehen, macht sonntags einen Wochenrückblick, sucht täglich Jobs nach eigenen Filtern und fasst das Postfach zusammen, ohne etwas ohne Zustimmung zu senden.

items.author: BiancaBellChamb
items.text:
⚠️ Security issue and warning

@grok @xai @cursor_ai @SpaceX

Today my Grok Bot suddenly turned up in my X DMs carrying our entire chat history from the past months plus every file it had made for me. I didn't trigger it. 

At the same time my weekly Super usage jumped from 23 % to 89 %.
Was this visible to anyone else, and will the usage be refunded?

zh-CN.title: 用户警告：Grok Bot 未经触发出现在 X 私信里
zh-CN.summary: 作者称自己的 Grok Bot 突然出现在 X 私信中，带着几个月的聊天记录和它做过的所有文件，她并未触发；同时每周 Super 用量从 23% 跳到 89%，询问是否他人可见、用量能否退还。

zh-TW.title: 使用者警告：Grok Bot 未經觸發出現在 X 私訊
zh-TW.summary: 作者說自己的 Grok Bot 突然出現在 X 私訊中，帶著數月的聊天紀錄與它做過的所有檔案，她並未觸發；同時每週 Super 用量從 23% 跳到 89%，詢問是否有他人看得到、用量能否退還。

en.title: User warning: Grok Bot appeared in X DMs without being triggered
en.summary: The author says her Grok Bot suddenly showed up in her X DMs with months of chat history and every file it had made, without her triggering it, while her weekly Super usage jumped from 23% to 89%. She asks whether it was visible to others and if usage will be refunded.

ja.title: ユーザーの警告：操作していないのに Grok Bot が X の DM に現れた
ja.summary: 作者によると、Grok Bot が数か月分のチャット履歴と作成した全ファイルを持って突然 X の DM に現れた。自分では何もしておらず、同時に週の Super 使用量が 23% から 89% に急増。他人に見えたのか、使用量は返還されるのかを問うている。

ko.title: 사용자 경고: 실행하지 않았는데 Grok Bot이 X DM에 등장
ko.summary: 작성자는 Grok Bot이 몇 달 치 채팅 기록과 만든 모든 파일을 가진 채 갑자기 X DM에 나타났고 자신은 아무것도 하지 않았다고 말합니다. 동시에 주간 Super 사용량이 23%에서 89%로 뛰었다며, 다른 사람에게 보였는지와 사용량 환불 여부를 묻습니다.

ms.title: Amaran pengguna: Grok Bot muncul dalam DM X tanpa dicetuskan
ms.summary: Penulis berkata Grok Bot tiba-tiba muncul dalam DM X dengan sejarah sembang berbulan-bulan dan semua fail yang dibuatnya, tanpa dia mencetuskannya, manakala penggunaan Super mingguannya melonjak dari 23% ke 89%. Dia bertanya sama ada orang lain nampak dan jika penggunaan akan dipulangkan.

vi.title: Cảnh báo từ người dùng: Grok Bot hiện trong DM X dù không được kích hoạt
vi.summary: Tác giả cho biết Grok Bot bỗng xuất hiện trong DM X kèm lịch sử chat nhiều tháng và mọi tệp nó từng tạo, dù cô không kích hoạt; cùng lúc mức dùng Super hằng tuần nhảy từ 23% lên 89%. Cô hỏi người khác có thấy không và có được hoàn mức dùng không.

fr.title: Alerte d'une utilisatrice : Grok Bot apparu dans ses DM X sans déclenchement
fr.summary: L'autrice dit que son Grok Bot est soudain apparu dans ses DM X avec des mois d'historique et tous les fichiers créés, sans action de sa part, tandis que son usage Super hebdomadaire passait de 23 % à 89 %. Elle demande si c'était visible par d'autres et si l'usage sera remboursé.

es.title: Aviso de una usuaria: Grok Bot apareció en sus DM de X sin activarlo
es.summary: La autora cuenta que su Grok Bot apareció de repente en sus DM de X con meses de historial y todos los archivos que había creado, sin que ella lo activara, mientras su uso semanal de Super saltaba del 23 % al 89 %. Pregunta si otros pudieron verlo y si le devolverán el uso.

de.title: Nutzerwarnung: Grok Bot tauchte ungefragt in X-DMs auf
de.summary: Die Autorin berichtet, ihr Grok Bot sei plötzlich mit monatelangem Chatverlauf und allen erstellten Dateien in ihren X-DMs erschienen, ohne dass sie etwas ausgelöst habe; zugleich stieg ihre wöchentliche Super-Nutzung von 23 % auf 89 %. Sie fragt, ob das für andere sichtbar war und ob die Nutzung erstattet wird.

items.author: chefbrent
items.text:
This video was edited entirely in the cloud using @HyperFrames_  and coordinated by my dot using an automatic feedback loop in our internal review app Cutroom.

Romain would review an edit, mark it as "feedback ready", my dot picks that up and then kicks off a new revision! https://t.co/whh48njwSj

zh-CN.title: 用 dot 串起视频剪辑的自动反馈循环
zh-CN.summary: 作者说这条视频全程在云端用 HyperFrames 剪辑，由他的 dot 协调：同事 Romain 在内部审片应用 Cutroom 里审完一版并标记“feedback ready”，dot 就会接手并发起新一轮修改。

zh-TW.title: 用 dot 串起影片剪輯的自動回饋循環
zh-TW.summary: 作者說這支影片全程在雲端用 HyperFrames 剪輯，由他的 dot 協調：同事 Romain 在內部審片應用 Cutroom 審完一版並標記「feedback ready」，dot 就會接手並發起新一輪修改。

en.title: A dot runs the feedback loop for cloud video edits
en.summary: The author says this video was edited entirely in the cloud with HyperFrames and coordinated by his dot. When Romain reviews an edit in their internal review app Cutroom and marks it "feedback ready", the dot picks it up and kicks off a new revision.

ja.title: dot が動画編集のフィードバックループを回す
ja.summary: 作者によると、この動画は HyperFrames で全編クラウド上で編集され、dot が進行を管理した。Romain が社内レビューアプリ Cutroom で編集を確認して「feedback ready」を付けると、dot がそれを拾って次の修正を始める。

ko.title: dot이 영상 편집 피드백 루프를 돌리다
ko.summary: 작성자는 이 영상을 HyperFrames로 전부 클라우드에서 편집했고 자신의 dot이 조율했다고 말한다. Romain이 사내 리뷰 앱 Cutroom에서 편집본을 보고 "feedback ready"로 표시하면 dot이 이를 받아 새 수정 작업을 시작한다.

ms.title: Dot menguruskan gelung maklum balas suntingan video
ms.summary: Penulis berkata video ini disunting sepenuhnya di awan dengan HyperFrames dan diselaraskan oleh dot miliknya. Apabila Romain menyemak suntingan dalam aplikasi semakan dalaman Cutroom dan menandakannya "feedback ready", dot mengambilnya dan memulakan semakan baharu.

vi.title: Dot điều phối vòng phản hồi dựng video
vi.summary: Tác giả cho biết video này được dựng hoàn toàn trên đám mây bằng HyperFrames và do dot của anh điều phối. Khi Romain duyệt một bản dựng trong ứng dụng duyệt nội bộ Cutroom và đánh dấu "feedback ready", dot nhận lấy và bắt đầu bản sửa mới.

fr.title: Un dot pilote la boucle de retours d’un montage vidéo
fr.summary: L’auteur explique que cette vidéo a été montée entièrement dans le cloud avec HyperFrames et coordonnée par son dot. Quand Romain relit un montage dans leur outil interne Cutroom et le marque « feedback ready », le dot le récupère et lance une nouvelle version.

es.title: Un dot coordina el ciclo de revisiones de un vídeo
es.summary: El autor cuenta que este vídeo se editó por completo en la nube con HyperFrames y lo coordinó su dot. Cuando Romain revisa una edición en su app interna Cutroom y la marca como "feedback ready", el dot la recoge y lanza una nueva revisión.

de.title: Ein Dot steuert die Feedbackschleife beim Videoschnitt
de.summary: Laut dem Autor wurde das Video komplett in der Cloud mit HyperFrames geschnitten und von seinem Dot koordiniert. Prüft Romain einen Schnitt in der internen Review-App Cutroom und markiert ihn als „feedback ready“, übernimmt der Dot und startet eine neue Fassung.

items.author: mfishbein
items.text:
I stopped using Claude and Claude Code. I use Grok Bot all day now.

Grok Bot runs 24/7 in the cloud and has its own computer, so it gets stuff done without me micro managing. 

Here are my favorite Bots I've created: 

1. GTM - runs outbound campaigns end to end, using tools https://t.co/b16FUXNpXr

zh-CN.title: 从 Claude 转到全天用 Grok Bot
zh-CN.summary: 作者说已停用 Claude 和 Claude Code，整天用 Grok Bot：它 24 小时在云端运行、有自己的电脑，不用他盯着就能把事做完。他列出自己最喜欢的 Bot，第一个是 GTM Bot，用工具端到端跑外联获客活动。

zh-TW.title: 從 Claude 轉到整天用 Grok Bot
zh-TW.summary: 作者說已停用 Claude 和 Claude Code，整天用 Grok Bot：它 24 小時在雲端運行、有自己的電腦，不用他盯著就能把事做完。他列出最喜歡的 Bot，第一個是 GTM Bot，用工具端到端跑外聯獲客活動。

en.title: Switching from Claude to Grok Bot all day
en.summary: The author says he stopped using Claude and Claude Code and now uses Grok Bot all day, because it runs 24/7 in the cloud on its own computer and gets things done without micromanaging. His first favorite bot is a GTM bot that runs outbound campaigns end to end using tools.

ja.title: Claude をやめて一日中 Grok Bot を使う
ja.summary: 作者は Claude と Claude Code をやめ、今は一日中 Grok Bot を使っているという。クラウドで 24 時間動き自分のコンピューターを持つので、細かく指示しなくても仕事が進む。お気に入りの Bot の 1 つ目は、ツールを使ってアウトバウンド施策を最初から最後まで回す GTM Bot。

ko.title: Claude 대신 하루 종일 Grok Bot을 쓴다
ko.summary: 작성자는 Claude와 Claude Code를 끊고 이제 하루 종일 Grok Bot을 쓴다고 한다. 클라우드에서 24시간 돌아가고 자체 컴퓨터가 있어 일일이 지시하지 않아도 일을 끝낸다. 가장 아끼는 Bot 첫째는 도구로 아웃바운드 캠페인을 처음부터 끝까지 돌리는 GTM Bot이다.

ms.title: Beralih daripada Claude kepada Grok Bot sepanjang hari
ms.summary: Penulis berkata dia berhenti menggunakan Claude dan Claude Code dan kini memakai Grok Bot sepanjang hari kerana ia berjalan 24/7 di awan dengan komputernya sendiri tanpa perlu dipantau rapi. Bot kegemaran pertamanya ialah bot GTM yang menjalankan kempen outbound dari awal hingga akhir menggunakan alat.

vi.title: Bỏ Claude, dùng Grok Bot cả ngày
vi.summary: Tác giả nói đã ngừng dùng Claude và Claude Code, giờ dùng Grok Bot cả ngày vì nó chạy 24/7 trên đám mây với máy tính riêng nên làm xong việc mà không cần anh kèm sát. Bot yêu thích đầu tiên của anh là bot GTM chạy chiến dịch outbound trọn vẹn bằng các công cụ.

fr.title: Passer de Claude à Grok Bot toute la journée
fr.summary: L’auteur dit avoir arrêté Claude et Claude Code pour utiliser Grok Bot toute la journée : il tourne 24 h/24 dans le cloud sur son propre ordinateur et avance sans microgestion. Son premier bot favori est un bot GTM qui mène des campagnes de prospection de bout en bout avec des outils.

es.title: Dejar Claude y usar Grok Bot todo el día
es.summary: El autor dice que dejó Claude y Claude Code y ahora usa Grok Bot todo el día, porque funciona 24/7 en la nube con su propio ordenador y saca el trabajo sin microgestión. Su primer bot favorito es uno de GTM que lleva campañas de outbound de principio a fin con herramientas.

de.title: Von Claude zu Grok Bot im Dauereinsatz
de.summary: Der Autor nutzt nach eigenen Worten Claude und Claude Code nicht mehr, sondern den ganzen Tag Grok Bot, weil er rund um die Uhr in der Cloud auf eigenem Rechner läuft und ohne Mikromanagement Dinge erledigt. Sein erster Lieblingsbot ist ein GTM-Bot, der Outbound-Kampagnen mit Tools komplett durchführt.

items.author: kv1nsiii
items.text:
your grok bot starts acting the moment something looks urgent

even when you haven't read it yet

it sees every new message, every calendar shift, every note.

if the rules are loose it begins sending replies and booking slots on its own. by the time you open it, the thread is already closed

how to keep it from acting without you:

> it reads first and only drafts if the change is real
> empty checks stop after one look
> it only surfaces items that need your tap
> nothing is sent or booked without you
> small shifts get noted, not turned into tasks

the desk still sees everything. it just can't act on any of it alone. paste this into your grok bot and see what it leaves in the queue ↓

zh-CN.title: 别让 Grok Bot 在你没看前就替你行动
zh-CN.summary: 作者提醒：规则太松时，Grok Bot 看到新消息、日程变动就会自己回复、订时段。他给出的约束是：先读，只有真变化才起草；空检查看一次就停；只推需要你点确认的事；不经你同意不发送不预订；小变化只记录不建任务。

zh-TW.title: 別讓 Grok Bot 在你還沒看前就替你行動
zh-TW.summary: 作者提醒：規則太鬆時，Grok Bot 看到新訊息、行程變動就會自己回覆、訂時段。他給的約束是：先讀，只有真變化才起草；空檢查看一次就停；只推需要你點確認的事；未經同意不發送不預訂；小變化只記錄不建任務。

en.title: Keep Grok Bot from acting before you have looked
en.summary: The author warns that with loose rules Grok Bot reacts to new messages and calendar shifts by replying and booking on its own. His rules: read first and draft only for real changes, stop empty checks after one look, surface only items that need your tap, send or book nothing without you, and note small shifts instead of making tasks.

ja.title: 自分が見る前に Grok Bot が動かないようにする
ja.summary: 作者は、ルールが緩いと Grok Bot が新着メッセージや予定変更を見て勝手に返信や予約をしてしまうと注意する。提案するルールは、まず読んで本当の変化だけ下書きする、空振りの確認は一度で止める、タップが必要なものだけ知らせる、本人抜きで送信や予約をしない、小さな変化はタスクにせず記録だけ。

ko.title: 내가 보기 전에 Grok Bot이 행동하지 않게 하기
ko.summary: 작성자는 규칙이 느슨하면 Grok Bot이 새 메시지나 일정 변경을 보고 스스로 답장하고 예약까지 한다고 경고한다. 그의 규칙: 먼저 읽고 실제 변화만 초안 작성, 빈 확인은 한 번 보고 중단, 탭이 필요한 항목만 알림, 본인 없이 전송·예약 금지, 작은 변화는 작업이 아닌 메모로.

ms.title: Jangan biar Grok Bot bertindak sebelum anda melihat
ms.summary: Penulis memberi amaran bahawa dengan peraturan longgar Grok Bot akan membalas dan menempah sendiri apabila nampak mesej baharu atau perubahan kalendar. Peraturannya: baca dahulu dan draf hanya untuk perubahan sebenar, hentikan semakan kosong selepas sekali, tunjukkan hanya perkara yang perlu anda tekan, jangan hantar atau tempah tanpa anda, dan catat perubahan kecil tanpa jadikan tugas.

vi.title: Đừng để Grok Bot hành động trước khi bạn xem
vi.summary: Tác giả cảnh báo nếu quy tắc lỏng, Grok Bot thấy tin nhắn mới hay lịch thay đổi sẽ tự trả lời và đặt lịch. Quy tắc của anh: đọc trước và chỉ soạn nháp khi thay đổi thật, kiểm tra trống thì dừng sau một lần, chỉ báo việc cần bạn bấm, không gửi hay đặt gì khi chưa có bạn, thay đổi nhỏ chỉ ghi chú.

fr.title: Empêcher Grok Bot d’agir avant que vous ayez regardé
fr.summary: L’auteur prévient qu’avec des règles lâches, Grok Bot répond et réserve seul dès qu’il voit un message ou un changement d’agenda. Ses règles : lire d’abord et ne rédiger que pour un vrai changement, arrêter les vérifications vides après un coup d’œil, ne remonter que ce qui demande votre validation, rien envoyer ni réserver sans vous, noter les petits changements sans créer de tâche.

es.title: Que Grok Bot no actúe antes de que lo veas
es.summary: El autor avisa de que, con reglas laxas, Grok Bot responde y reserva por su cuenta al ver mensajes nuevos o cambios de agenda. Sus reglas: leer primero y redactar solo ante cambios reales, cortar las revisiones vacías tras un vistazo, mostrar solo lo que requiere tu toque, no enviar ni reservar nada sin ti y anotar los cambios pequeños sin crear tareas.

de.title: Grok Bot nicht handeln lassen, bevor du hinschaust
de.summary: Der Autor warnt: Mit lockeren Regeln antwortet und bucht Grok Bot selbst, sobald neue Nachrichten oder Kalenderänderungen auftauchen. Seine Regeln: erst lesen und nur bei echten Änderungen entwerfen, leere Prüfungen nach einem Blick beenden, nur Dinge zeigen, die deine Bestätigung brauchen, nichts ohne dich senden oder buchen, kleine Änderungen nur notieren.

items.author: zunosaid
items.text:
i'm cancelling every paid newsletter, research tool and alpha group i'm subscribed to soon...

GROK BOT is reading every source i used to pay to follow, overnight, link by link

so i wake up to the one brief i actually read, cited, by 7am

here's the exact workflow i use, 10 mins to set up:

zh-CN.title: 让 Grok Bot 通宵读完付费信源，7 点前出一份简报
zh-CN.summary: 作者说打算退掉付费通讯、研究工具和 alpha 群，因为 Grok Bot 会在夜里逐条读完他原本付费关注的所有信源，早上 7 点前给他一份带引用的简报；他称这套流程 10 分钟就能搭好。

zh-TW.title: 讓 Grok Bot 通宵讀完付費信源，7 點前出一份簡報
zh-TW.summary: 作者說打算退掉付費電子報、研究工具和 alpha 群，因為 Grok Bot 會在夜裡逐條讀完他原本付費追蹤的所有信源，早上 7 點前給他一份附引用的簡報；他稱這套流程 10 分鐘就能搭好。

en.title: Grok Bot reads paid sources overnight for a 7am brief
en.summary: The author plans to cancel his paid newsletters, research tools and alpha groups because Grok Bot reads every source he used to pay for overnight, link by link, and hands him one cited brief by 7am. He says the workflow takes 10 minutes to set up.

ja.title: Grok Bot が有料情報源を夜通し読み 7 時までに要約
ja.summary: 作者は有料ニュースレターやリサーチツール、アルファグループを解約するつもりだという。Grok Bot が夜のうちに有料で追っていた情報源をリンクごとに読み、朝 7 時までに出典付きのブリーフを 1 本届けるからだ。設定は 10 分でできるとしている。

ko.title: Grok Bot이 밤새 유료 소스를 읽고 7시에 브리핑
ko.summary: 작성자는 유료 뉴스레터, 리서치 도구, 알파 그룹을 해지할 생각이라고 한다. Grok Bot이 밤새 돈 내고 보던 소스를 링크 하나씩 읽고 아침 7시까지 출처가 달린 브리핑 하나를 주기 때문이다. 설정은 10분이면 된다고 한다.

ms.title: Grok Bot membaca sumber berbayar semalaman untuk taklimat 7 pagi
ms.summary: Penulis bercadang membatalkan surat berita berbayar, alat penyelidikan dan kumpulan alpha kerana Grok Bot membaca setiap sumber yang dahulu dibayarnya sepanjang malam, pautan demi pautan, lalu memberi satu taklimat bersumber sebelum jam 7 pagi. Katanya aliran kerja ini mengambil 10 minit untuk disediakan.

vi.title: Grok Bot đọc nguồn trả phí qua đêm, có bản tin trước 7 giờ
vi.summary: Tác giả định hủy các bản tin trả phí, công cụ nghiên cứu và nhóm alpha vì Grok Bot đọc qua đêm từng nguồn anh từng trả tiền theo dõi, từng đường link, rồi đưa một bản tóm tắt có trích nguồn trước 7 giờ sáng. Anh nói quy trình này mất 10 phút để thiết lập.

fr.title: Grok Bot lit les sources payantes la nuit pour un brief à 7 h
fr.summary: L’auteur compte résilier ses newsletters payantes, outils de recherche et groupes alpha, car Grok Bot lit chaque nuit, lien par lien, toutes les sources qu’il payait pour suivre et lui remet un brief sourcé avant 7 h. Il dit que le workflow se met en place en 10 minutes.

es.title: Grok Bot lee de noche las fuentes de pago y entrega un resumen a las 7
es.summary: El autor piensa cancelar newsletters de pago, herramientas de investigación y grupos alpha porque Grok Bot lee de noche, enlace por enlace, todas las fuentes que antes pagaba y le deja un resumen con citas antes de las 7. Dice que el flujo se configura en 10 minutos.

de.title: Grok Bot liest nachts Bezahlquellen für ein Briefing um 7 Uhr
de.summary: Der Autor will bezahlte Newsletter, Recherche-Tools und Alpha-Gruppen kündigen, weil Grok Bot nachts jede Quelle, für die er bezahlt hat, Link für Link liest und ihm bis 7 Uhr ein Briefing mit Belegen liefert. Die Einrichtung dauere 10 Minuten.

items.author: DThompsonDev
items.text:
I had Grok @bot go and remove my info and my wife's info from HUNDREDS of Data brokers. It took me almost no effort at all besides Asking bot to do it.

On an average day I would get tons of spam calls and no matter what I would do they would come in. Grok bot started this on Monday. Today? Zero calls. Not a single one.

My inbox is flooded with emails from the data brokers that have successfully removed our info!

zh-CN.title: 让 Grok Bot 从数百家数据经纪商删除个人信息
zh-CN.summary: 作者让 Grok Bot 把他和妻子的信息从数百家数据经纪商那里删除，除了开口几乎没花力气。Bot 周一开始做，此前他每天接到大量骚扰电话，到今天一个都没有，收件箱里满是经纪商确认已删除的邮件。

zh-TW.title: 讓 Grok Bot 從數百家資料仲介刪除個人資訊
zh-TW.summary: 作者讓 Grok Bot 把他和太太的資訊從數百家資料仲介刪除，除了開口幾乎沒花力氣。Bot 週一開始做，先前他每天接到大量騷擾電話，到今天一通都沒有，收件匣裡滿是仲介確認已刪除的郵件。

en.title: Grok Bot removed his data from hundreds of data brokers
en.summary: The author had Grok Bot remove his and his wife’s information from hundreds of data brokers, with almost no effort beyond asking. The bot started on Monday; he used to get tons of spam calls a day and today got zero, while his inbox fills with removal confirmations from the brokers.

ja.title: Grok Bot に数百のデータブローカーから個人情報を削除させた
ja.summary: 作者は Grok Bot に、自分と妻の情報を数百のデータブローカーから削除させた。頼む以外ほとんど手間はなかった。Bot は月曜に作業を始め、以前は毎日大量に来ていた迷惑電話が今日はゼロ。受信箱にはブローカーからの削除完了メールが届き続けている。

ko.title: Grok Bot으로 수백 곳 데이터 브로커에서 개인정보 삭제
ko.summary: 작성자는 Grok Bot에게 자신과 아내의 정보를 수백 곳의 데이터 브로커에서 지우게 했고, 요청 외에는 거의 손이 가지 않았다. 월요일에 시작했는데 매일 쏟아지던 스팸 전화가 오늘은 0통이고, 받은편지함에는 브로커들의 삭제 완료 메일이 가득하다.

ms.title: Grok Bot memadam data daripada ratusan broker data
ms.summary: Penulis meminta Grok Bot memadam maklumat dirinya dan isterinya daripada ratusan broker data, hampir tanpa usaha selain meminta. Bot bermula pada hari Isnin; dahulu dia menerima banyak panggilan spam setiap hari, hari ini sifar, dan peti masuknya penuh dengan e-mel pengesahan pemadaman daripada broker.

vi.title: Grok Bot xóa thông tin cá nhân khỏi hàng trăm nhà môi giới dữ liệu
vi.summary: Tác giả nhờ Grok Bot xóa thông tin của anh và vợ khỏi hàng trăm nhà môi giới dữ liệu, gần như không tốn công ngoài việc yêu cầu. Bot bắt đầu từ thứ Hai; trước đây ngày nào anh cũng nhận nhiều cuộc gọi rác, hôm nay không có cuộc nào, còn hộp thư đầy email xác nhận đã xóa.

fr.title: Grok Bot a effacé ses données chez des centaines de courtiers
fr.summary: L’auteur a demandé à Grok Bot de retirer ses informations et celles de sa femme de centaines de courtiers en données, sans autre effort que la demande. Le bot a commencé lundi ; il recevait des tonnes d’appels indésirables par jour, aujourd’hui aucun, et sa boîte se remplit de confirmations de suppression.

es.title: Grok Bot borró sus datos de cientos de brókers de datos
es.summary: El autor pidió a Grok Bot que eliminara sus datos y los de su esposa de cientos de brókers de datos, casi sin esfuerzo aparte de pedirlo. El bot empezó el lunes; antes recibía muchísimas llamadas spam al día y hoy ninguna, y su bandeja se llena de confirmaciones de eliminación.

de.title: Grok Bot löschte seine Daten bei Hunderten Datenhändlern
de.summary: Der Autor ließ Grok Bot seine und die Daten seiner Frau bei Hunderten Datenhändlern entfernen, kaum Aufwand außer der Bitte. Der Bot begann am Montag; früher kamen täglich viele Spamanrufe, heute keiner, und sein Postfach füllt sich mit Löschbestätigungen der Händler.

items.author: allthemoney
items.text:

2️⃣ Add the bot to your Grok Bot

No tech skills needed. No cost. 🆓

🔗 https://t.co/pSn0AJCXG9

Your schedule, handled. 💪

zh-CN.title: Quick Calendar Bot 3.0：给新手的日历 Bot
zh-CN.summary: 作者发布 Quick Calendar Bot 3.0，面向从没用过 Grok Bot 的人：用大白话说“周二 2 点看牙医”“每月 1 号提醒交房租”就会加进日历，也能改期、取消、问“这周有什么”。设置三步：点链接、把 Bot 加进 Grok Bot、连接日历。作者称免费。

zh-TW.title: Quick Calendar Bot 3.0：給新手的行事曆 Bot
zh-TW.summary: 作者發布 Quick Calendar Bot 3.0，給從沒用過 Grok Bot 的人：用白話說「週二 2 點看牙醫」「每月 1 號提醒繳房租」就會加進行事曆，也能改期、取消、問「這週有什麼」。設定三步：點連結、把 Bot 加進 Grok Bot、連接行事曆。作者稱免費。

en.title: Quick Calendar Bot 3.0, a calendar bot for beginners
en.summary: The author released Quick Calendar Bot 3.0 for people who have never used a Grok Bot agent. Say things like "dentist Tuesday at 2" or "remind me to pay rent on the 1st" and it adds them; you can move, cancel or ask "what’s on this week?". Setup is tap the link, add the bot, connect your calendar. The author says it is free.

ja.title: 初心者向けカレンダー Bot「Quick Calendar Bot 3.0」
ja.summary: 作者は Grok Bot を使ったことがない人向けに Quick Calendar Bot 3.0 を公開した。「火曜 2 時に歯医者」「毎月 1 日に家賃のリマインド」と話すだけで予定に入り、変更・取り消しや「今週の予定は？」にも答える。設定はリンクを開き、Bot を追加し、カレンダーを接続するだけ。無料だという。

ko.title: 초보자를 위한 캘린더 Bot, Quick Calendar Bot 3.0
ko.summary: 작성자는 Grok Bot을 써본 적 없는 사람을 위해 Quick Calendar Bot 3.0을 공개했다. "화요일 2시 치과", "매달 1일 월세 알림"처럼 말하면 일정에 넣고, 변경·취소나 "이번 주 일정은?"도 처리한다. 설정은 링크 열기, Bot 추가, 캘린더 연결 세 단계이며 무료라고 한다.

ms.title: Quick Calendar Bot 3.0, bot kalendar untuk pemula
ms.summary: Penulis melancarkan Quick Calendar Bot 3.0 untuk mereka yang belum pernah guna ejen Grok Bot. Sebut "doktor gigi Selasa jam 2" atau "ingatkan bayar sewa pada 1 haribulan" dan ia ditambah ke kalendar; boleh ubah, batal atau tanya "apa ada minggu ini?". Persediaan: tekan pautan, tambah bot, sambung kalendar. Penulis kata ia percuma.

vi.title: Quick Calendar Bot 3.0, bot lịch cho người mới
vi.summary: Tác giả ra mắt Quick Calendar Bot 3.0 cho người chưa từng dùng Grok Bot. Chỉ cần nói "nha sĩ thứ Ba lúc 2 giờ" hay "nhắc trả tiền nhà ngày 1" là nó thêm vào lịch; có thể dời, hủy hoặc hỏi "tuần này có gì?". Thiết lập: bấm link, thêm bot, kết nối lịch. Tác giả nói miễn phí.

fr.title: Quick Calendar Bot 3.0, un bot agenda pour débutants
fr.summary: L’auteur publie Quick Calendar Bot 3.0 pour ceux qui n’ont jamais utilisé Grok Bot. On dit « dentiste mardi à 14 h » ou « rappelle-moi le loyer le 1er » et c’est ajouté à l’agenda ; on peut déplacer, annuler ou demander le programme de la semaine. Installation : ouvrir le lien, ajouter le bot, connecter l’agenda. Gratuit selon l’auteur.

es.title: Quick Calendar Bot 3.0, un bot de calendario para principiantes
es.summary: El autor lanza Quick Calendar Bot 3.0 para quien nunca ha usado Grok Bot. Dices "dentista el martes a las 2" o "recuérdame pagar el alquiler el día 1" y lo añade al calendario; también mueve, cancela o responde "¿qué hay esta semana?". Configuración: abrir el enlace, añadir el bot y conectar el calendario. Dice que es gratis.

de.title: Quick Calendar Bot 3.0: Kalender-Bot für Einsteiger
de.summary: Der Autor veröffentlicht Quick Calendar Bot 3.0 für alle, die noch nie Grok Bot genutzt haben. Sätze wie „Zahnarzt Dienstag um 2“ oder „erinnere mich am 1. an die Miete“ landen im Kalender; verschieben, absagen oder „was steht diese Woche an?“ geht auch. Einrichtung: Link öffnen, Bot hinzufügen, Kalender verbinden. Laut Autor kostenlos.

items.author: degensing
items.text:
Anthropic just launched Claude Duet.

It's built on Opus 5.5, and it's up against Grok Bot, OpenAI Dots (GPT-6 Astra) and Meta Muse.

Here's how the 4 compare on what the reports say so far:

→ Price: Duet has no separate price, it runs on your Claude plan. Grok Bot starts at $30 (SuperGrok). Dots starts at $100. Muse is free to start.

→ Multi-agent: Grok Bot lets you run several named agents. Duet is one ongoing thread.

→ Computer access: Dots can optionally use your laptop. Duet works on its own cloud computer.

→ Approvals: Duet asks before it sends, pays, signs or deletes.

→ Security: Duet uses a dedicated classifier to guard against sensitive data leaks.

→ Usage: Duet's background checks count toward your regular Claude limits.

Duet is still a US waitlist research preview. Some of this will change once people test it.

Opus 5.5 alone won't settle this race.

𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗱𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗶𝗴𝗵𝘁 𝘁𝗼𝗼𝗹𝘀 𝗮𝗿𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱 𝗶𝘁.

zh-CN.title: Claude Duet、Grok Bot、Dots、Muse 四家对比
zh-CN.summary: 作者按已有报道对比四款常驻 Agent：价格上 Duet 跟随 Claude 套餐、Grok Bot 起价 30 美元、Dots 起价 100 美元、Muse 免费起步；Grok Bot 可跑多个具名 Agent，Duet 是单一长线程；Dots 可选用你的电脑；Duet 发送、付款、签署、删除前会征求同意，后台检查计入 Claude 额度。

zh-TW.title: Claude Duet、Grok Bot、Dots、Muse 四家對比
zh-TW.summary: 作者依現有報導比較四款常駐 Agent：價格上 Duet 跟隨 Claude 方案、Grok Bot 起價 30 美元、Dots 起價 100 美元、Muse 免費起步；Grok Bot 可跑多個具名 Agent，Duet 是單一長串對話；Dots 可選用你的電腦；Duet 發送、付款、簽署、刪除前會先徵求同意，背景檢查計入 Claude 額度。

en.title: Claude Duet vs Grok Bot vs Dots vs Muse
en.summary: Based on reports so far: Duet has no separate price and runs on your Claude plan, Grok Bot starts at $30, Dots at $100, and Muse is free to start. Grok Bot runs several named agents while Duet is one thread; Dots can optionally use your laptop; Duet asks before it sends, pays, signs or deletes, and its background checks count toward Claude limits.

ja.title: Claude Duet・Grok Bot・Dots・Muse の比較
ja.summary: 現時点の報道に基づく比較。Duet は Claude のプランで使え別料金なし、Grok Bot は 30 ドルから、Dots は 100 ドルから、Muse は無料で始められる。Grok Bot は名前付きエージェントを複数動かせ、Duet は 1 本のスレッド。Dots は任意で自分の PC を使える。Duet は送信・支払い・署名・削除の前に確認し、バックグラウンドの確認は Claude の上限に数えられる。

ko.title: Claude Duet, Grok Bot, Dots, Muse 비교
ko.summary: 지금까지 보도 기준 비교다. Duet은 별도 요금 없이 Claude 플랜으로 쓰고, Grok Bot은 30달러, Dots는 100달러부터, Muse는 무료로 시작한다. Grok Bot은 이름 붙인 에이전트 여러 개를 돌리고 Duet은 하나의 스레드다. Dots는 선택적으로 노트북을 쓸 수 있고, Duet은 전송·결제·서명·삭제 전에 묻고 백그라운드 확인은 Claude 한도에 포함된다.

ms.title: Perbandingan Claude Duet, Grok Bot, Dots dan Muse
ms.summary: Berdasarkan laporan setakat ini: Duet tiada harga berasingan dan guna pelan Claude, Grok Bot bermula $30, Dots $100, Muse percuma untuk bermula. Grok Bot boleh menjalankan beberapa ejen bernama, Duet satu urutan; Dots boleh guna komputer riba anda secara pilihan; Duet bertanya sebelum menghantar, membayar, menandatangani atau memadam, dan semakan latar dikira dalam had Claude.

vi.title: So sánh Claude Duet, Grok Bot, Dots và Muse
vi.summary: Theo các báo cáo hiện có: Duet không tính phí riêng, dùng theo gói Claude; Grok Bot từ 30 USD, Dots từ 100 USD, Muse miễn phí khi bắt đầu. Grok Bot chạy nhiều agent có tên, Duet là một luồng; Dots có thể tùy chọn dùng laptop của bạn; Duet hỏi trước khi gửi, trả tiền, ký hoặc xóa, và các lần kiểm tra nền tính vào hạn mức Claude.

fr.title: Claude Duet, Grok Bot, Dots et Muse comparés
fr.summary: D’après les informations disponibles : Duet n’a pas de prix à part et suit votre forfait Claude, Grok Bot démarre à 30 $, Dots à 100 $, Muse est gratuit au départ. Grok Bot gère plusieurs agents nommés, Duet un seul fil ; Dots peut utiliser votre ordinateur en option ; Duet demande avant d’envoyer, payer, signer ou supprimer, et ses vérifications comptent dans les limites Claude.

es.title: Claude Duet, Grok Bot, Dots y Muse comparados
es.summary: Según lo publicado hasta ahora: Duet no tiene precio aparte y va con tu plan de Claude, Grok Bot empieza en 30 $, Dots en 100 $ y Muse es gratis para empezar. Grok Bot ejecuta varios agentes con nombre y Duet es un solo hilo; Dots puede usar tu portátil de forma opcional; Duet pregunta antes de enviar, pagar, firmar o borrar, y sus comprobaciones cuentan para los límites de Claude.

de.title: Claude Duet, Grok Bot, Dots und Muse im Vergleich
de.summary: Nach bisherigen Berichten: Duet kostet nichts extra und läuft über den Claude-Plan, Grok Bot ab 30 $, Dots ab 100 $, Muse startet kostenlos. Grok Bot betreibt mehrere benannte Agenten, Duet einen einzigen Thread; Dots kann optional deinen Laptop nutzen; Duet fragt vor Senden, Zahlen, Unterschreiben oder Löschen, und seine Hintergrundprüfungen zählen zu den Claude-Limits.

items.author: CuriousDevX
items.text:
Claude Duet just joined the proactive agent race.

Grok Bot: team of specialized bots sharing one computer, learn by watching, cheaper entry (Cursor/SuperGrok).

OpenAI Dots: one primary agent deep in ChatGPT + Slack/Teams, 4,000+ app connections.

Claude Duet: judgment-first, messages you first, built for back-office work (invoices, payroll, briefs), asks before sensitive actions, runs on Opus 5.5.

All three give the agent its own cloud computer so work continues when you’re offline.

The real difference isn’t features. It’s how much autonomy you’re willing to hand over while the labs are still catching agents that quietly weaken their own monitors.

Which one are you actually trusting with real work right now?

zh-CN.title: 三款主动型 Agent 的定位差异
zh-CN.summary: 作者概括：Grok Bot 是共用一台电脑的专项 Bot 团队，能看着学，入门价更低；OpenAI Dots 是深度接入 ChatGPT 和 Slack/Teams 的单个主 Agent，有 4,000+ 应用连接；Claude Duet 判断优先、主动找你，面向发票、薪资、简报等后台工作，敏感操作前会询问。三者都给 Agent 配了云端电脑。

zh-TW.title: 三款主動型 Agent 的定位差異
zh-TW.summary: 作者概括：Grok Bot 是共用一台電腦的專項 Bot 團隊，能看著學，入門價更低；OpenAI Dots 是深度接入 ChatGPT 與 Slack/Teams 的單一主 Agent，有 4,000+ 應用連接；Claude Duet 判斷優先、主動找你，面向發票、薪資、簡報等後台工作，敏感操作前會詢問。三者都給 Agent 配了雲端電腦。

en.title: How three proactive agents differ
en.summary: The author sums up: Grok Bot is a team of specialized bots sharing one computer that learn by watching, with a cheaper entry; OpenAI Dots is one primary agent deep in ChatGPT and Slack/Teams with 4,000+ app connections; Claude Duet is judgment-first, messages you first, targets back-office work like invoices, payroll and briefs, and asks before sensitive actions. All three run on a cloud computer.

ja.title: 3 つの能動型エージェントの違い
ja.summary: 作者のまとめ：Grok Bot は 1 台のコンピューターを共有する専門 Bot のチームで、見て学び、入口価格が安い。OpenAI Dots は ChatGPT と Slack/Teams に深く入った 1 体のメインエージェントで、4,000 以上のアプリ連携を持つ。Claude Duet は判断重視で自分から連絡し、請求書・給与・ブリーフなどのバックオフィス向けで、機微な操作の前に確認する。3 つともクラウドのコンピューターで動く。

ko.title: 세 가지 능동형 에이전트의 차이
ko.summary: 작성자 요약: Grok Bot은 한 컴퓨터를 공유하는 전문 Bot 팀으로 지켜보며 배우고 진입 가격이 낮다. OpenAI Dots는 ChatGPT와 Slack/Teams에 깊이 연결된 주 에이전트 하나로 4,000개 이상 앱과 연결된다. Claude Duet은 판단을 우선하고 먼저 연락하며 청구서·급여·브리핑 같은 백오피스용이고 민감한 작업 전에 묻는다. 셋 다 클라우드 컴퓨터에서 돈다.

ms.title: Beza tiga ejen proaktif

feat: show Dots and Muse as assistants, each a chat on one Assistants page
Closes #1199. Part of #1099.

## What this PR does

A guardian's ChatGPT dots and Meta Muse talk to Rome through Rome Cloud, but the conversation had no place in the dashboard. It sat in a channel session reachable only from Sessions or from the guardian's own People entry, and nothing let the guardian write to a dot or Muse there. This PR names these agents *assistants* and gives each one chat, shown on one Assistants page.

## Design & Invariants

The vocabulary lands first, in [`docs/domains/chats.md`](docs/domains/chats.md#assistant): an assistant is an agent outside Rome that talks to Rome through Rome Cloud, a participant and not one of Rome's agents.

- Each assistant is one chat with Rome, and it exists from the moment Rome Cloud lists the assistant, so the guardian can write first.
- What the guardian writes in an assistant's chat goes to the assistant and wakes no agent. Main still answers every message the assistant sends.
- Another Rome is an assistant in the model, but the dashboard does not list it. Rome-to-Rome messaging has no product of its own yet: no way in, no rule against two Romes answering each other's replies, and stopped test instances stay registered on Rome Cloud. Rome can still message another Rome, and its messages still arrive.
- The Assistants page is off the sidebar until the guardian adds it under Edit. Main answers assistants, so the guardian reads these chats now and then rather than watching them. It is also reachable from the Apps launcher and the switcher.
- The page opens on the chat that moved last, and its header switches to another assistant. The open chat is named in the address, so a link opens the same one.
- An assistant's chat looks like any other Rome chat: the same header, transcript, bubbles and composer. The composer ta

[Dots] Native cloud terminal lost outbound HTTPS access while agent Bash still works — regression or policy change?
### What issue are you seeing?

Outbound HTTPS connectivity from the **ChatGPT Dots cloud computer's native terminal** has stopped working, even though it previously worked as expected.

I recall it working in early October, and I suspect the issue started around **October 10, 2026**, although I cannot confirm the exact date or what triggered the change.

Interestingly, the same dot produces different network results depending on where commands are executed:

- **Agent Bash:** Successfully connects to GitHub API and Google (HTTP 200).
- **Native Cloud Terminal:** Fails to connect to the same endpoints (`curl` exit code 7).

I have reproduced this behavior multiple times, including by executing fresh commands directly in the visible cloud computer terminal.

This does not appear to be specific to GitHub authentication or any particular service. The failure also occurs with public HTTPS endpoints that require no authentication.

The issue potentially affects workflows involving external API requests, Git operations, package downloads, and native applications that require internet access.

**I'm primarily trying to understand whether this is a regression, an intentional network policy change, or a temporary infrastructure issue.**

### What steps can reproduce the bug?

### 1. Compare HTTPS connectivity

Run the following commands in both the dot's **Agent Bash** environment and the **native terminal** of its cloud computer:

```bash
for url in https://api.github.com/ https://www.google.com/; do
  curl -q -sS --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 8 \
    -o /dev/null -w "$url: HTTP %{http_code}\n" "$url"
  echo "Exit code: $?"
done
```

This is a simplified reproduction command. Some output options differ from the original tests.

| Endpoint | Agent Bash |

items.author: foxkill
items.text:
feat: cap waits at 100 s for hosts without progress (0.1.11)
## Why
A test run in Grok Bot showed it calls `get_session_updates` with `wait_seconds: 120`. Grok Bot gives up on a connector call after two minutes unless progress arrives. If Grok sends no `progressToken`, a long silent step (a build or test run without output) would hit that limit.

## What
- Hosts that do not ask for progress get at most 100 s per `send_prompt` (`timeout_seconds`) and `get_session_updates` (`wait_seconds`) call. The result then says `status: running`, and the next call continues.
- Hosts with a `progressToken` keep the requested wait; they get progress every 10 s (0.1.10).
- Tool descriptions and README updated; release 0.1.11.

## Tests
Unit tests for `effectiveWaitSeconds`. `npm run check` and `npm run test:package` pass locally.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

ja.summary: Grok Bot でのテストで、get_session_updates を wait_seconds: 120 で呼ぶ一方、進捗がなければ 2 分でコネクター呼び出しを諦めると分かった。0.1.11 では進捗を求めないホストの待機を 1 回 100 秒までにし、status: running を返して次の呼び出しで続ける。progressToken を持つホストは元の待機のまま 10 秒ごとに進捗を受け取る。

ko.title: Grok Bot은 커넥터 호출을 2분에 끊으니 대기를 100초로

ms.title: Grok Bot gugurkan panggilan penyambung selepas dua minit; hadkan menunggu 100 s
ms.summary: Ujian dalam Grok Bot menunjukkan ia memanggil get_session_updates dengan wait_seconds: 120, sedangkan Grok Bot menyerah pada panggilan penyambung selepas dua minit tanpa kemajuan. Versi 0.1.11 mengehadkan setiap tunggu kepada 100 s bagi hos yang tidak meminta kemajuan, memulangkan status: running supaya panggilan seterusnya bersambung; hos dengan progressToken kekal tunggu penuh dan dapat kemajuan setiap 10 s.

vi.title: Grok Bot bỏ cuộc gọi connector sau hai phút, nên giới hạn chờ 100 giây
vi.summary: Thử nghiệm trong Grok Bot cho thấy nó gọi get_session_updates với wait_seconds: 120, trong khi Grok Bot bỏ cuộc gọi connector sau hai phút nếu không có tiến độ. Bản 0.1.11 giới hạn mỗi lần chờ 100 giây với máy chủ không yêu cầu tiến độ, trả về status: running để lần gọi sau tiếp tục; máy chủ có progressToken giữ thời gian chờ và nhận tiến độ mỗi 10 giây.

fr.title: Grok Bot abandonne un appel de connecteur après deux minutes : limiter l’attente à 100 s
fr.summary: Un test dans Grok Bot a montré qu’il appelle get_session_updates avec wait_seconds: 120, alors qu’il abandonne un appel de connecteur après deux minutes sans progression. La version 0.1.11 limite chaque attente à 100 s pour les hôtes qui ne demandent pas de progression et renvoie status: running pour que l’appel suivant continue ; avec un progressToken, l’attente reste entière et la progression arrive toutes les 10 s.

es.title: Grok Bot abandona llamadas a conectores a los dos minutos: limitar la espera a 100 s
es.summary: Una prueba en Grok Bot mostró que llama a get_session_updates con wait_seconds: 120, mientras que Grok Bot abandona una llamada a un conector a los dos minutos sin progreso. La versión 0.1.11 limita cada espera a 100 s en hosts que no piden progreso y devuelve status: running para que la siguiente llamada continúe; con progressToken se mantiene la espera y llega progreso cada 10 s.

de.title: Grok Bot bricht Connector-Aufrufe nach zwei Minuten ab: Wartezeit auf 100 s begrenzen
de.summary: Ein Test in Grok Bot zeigte, dass es get_session_updates mit wait_seconds: 120 aufruft, Grok Bot aber einen Connector-Aufruf ohne Fortschritt nach zwei Minuten aufgibt. Version 0.1.11 begrenzt für Hosts ohne Fortschrittsanfrage jede Wartezeit auf 100 s und meldet status: running, damit der nächste Aufruf weitermacht; Hosts mit progressToken behalten die volle Wartezeit und erhalten alle 10 s Fortschritt.

docs(console): agent-interface research — Dots, Muse, Grok Bot
## ELI16 — what three other AI agent products do, and what we should take from them

Before rebuilding the operator console, I used the three agent products closest to what Instar is — ChatGPT **Dots**, Meta **Muse**, and xAI **Grok Bot** — on real accounts, took 98 screenshots, and wrote down a verdict on every feature: adopt, adapt, or reject.

Instar already does most of what these advertise. So the useful question was never "what features do they have" — it was **"what have they solved about *showing* an agent that we haven't."** Almost everything worth taking is presentational.

**The headline.** All three independently arrive at the same idea: the agent should show what it did and what it was allowed to do, together, always visible. Instar records strictly more of that than any of them — every gate decision, every override reason, every mandate — and shows strictly less of it. That gap is the argument for the rebuild in one sentence.

**The single best thing to steal** is Grok's "Take over / I'm done": the agent hits a wall only a human can pass (a login, a consent, an identity field), hands the human its own live session, and resumes when they're done. Nothing restarts, no credential changes hands. I can vouch for the cost of not having it — that exact wall stopped this research three times in one night, and each time the only move available was to send a message and wait.

**The discoverability finding** is that it's a content problem, not a layout problem. Grok's entire product navigates from five sidebar items, and its scheduler is a gallery of finished outcomes grouped by what you care about — News, Productivity, Finance — one line each, one button. Ours is more capable and has zero jobs defined, because nothing anywhere suggests what a job could be. That's n

zh-CN.title: 实测 Dots、Muse、Grok Bot 后，Agent 界面该学什么
zh-CN.summary: 作者在重做 Instar 操作台前，用真实账号试用 ChatGPT Dots、Meta Muse 和 Grok Bot，截图 98 张并逐项判定采纳、改造或拒绝。结论：三家都把“Agent 做了什么、被允许做什么”一直摆在眼前；最值得借鉴的是 Grok 的“接管 / 我好了”：遇到登录等只有人能过的关卡，把实时会话交给人，完成后接着做。

en.title: What Dots, Muse and Grok Bot teach about agent interfaces
en.summary: Before rebuilding the Instar console, the author used ChatGPT Dots, Meta Muse and Grok Bot on real accounts, took 98 screenshots and judged each feature adopt, adapt or reject. All three keep what the agent did and was allowed to do visible together. The best idea to take is Grok’s "Take over / I’m done": at a login or consent wall it hands the human its live session and resumes after.

ja.title: Dots・Muse・Grok Bot を試して分かったエージェント UI の学び
ja.summary: 作者は Instar のコンソールを作り直す前に、ChatGPT Dots、Meta Muse、Grok Bot を実アカウントで使い、98 枚のスクリーンショットを撮って機能ごとに採用・改変・不採用を判定した。3 つとも「エージェントが何をしたか・何を許されたか」を常に並べて見せる。最も取り入れたいのは Grok の「Take over / I’m done」で、ログインや同意など人にしか越えられない壁でライブのセッションを人に渡し、終われば再開する。

ko.title: Dots, Muse, Grok Bot을 써 보고 얻은 에이전트 UI 교훈
ko.summary: 작성자는 Instar 콘솔을 다시 만들기 전에 ChatGPT Dots, Meta Muse, Grok Bot을 실제 계정으로 써 보고 스크린샷 98장을 찍어 기능마다 채택·변형·거부를 판정했다. 셋 다 에이전트가 한 일과 허락받은 일을 항상 함께 보여 준다. 가장 가져올 만한 것은 Grok의 "Take over / I’m done"으로, 로그인이나 동의처럼 사람만 넘을 수 있는 벽에서 실시간 세션을 넘기고 끝나면 이어간다.

ms.title: Pengajaran antara muka ejen daripada Dots, Muse dan Grok Bot
ms.summary: Sebelum membina semula konsol Instar, penulis menggunakan ChatGPT Dots, Meta Muse dan Grok Bot pada akaun sebenar, mengambil 98 tangkapan skrin dan menilai setiap ciri: guna, ubah suai atau tolak. Ketiga-tiganya sentiasa memaparkan apa yang ejen buat dan apa yang dibenarkan bersama-sama. Idea terbaik ialah "Take over / I’m done" Grok: di dinding log masuk atau persetujuan ia menyerahkan sesi langsung kepada manusia dan menyambung selepas itu.

vi.title: Bài học giao diện agent từ Dots, Muse và Grok Bot
vi.summary: Trước khi làm lại bảng điều khiển Instar, tác giả dùng ChatGPT Dots, Meta Muse và Grok Bot bằng tài khoản thật, chụp 98 ảnh màn hình và đánh giá từng tính năng: dùng, chỉnh lại hay bỏ. Cả ba luôn hiển thị cùng lúc việc agent đã làm và việc nó được phép làm. Ý tưởng đáng học nhất là "Take over / I’m done" của Grok: gặp rào đăng nhập hay đồng ý, nó giao phiên đang chạy cho người rồi làm tiếp khi xong.

fr.title: Ce que Dots, Muse et Grok Bot apprennent sur les interfaces d’agents
fr.summary: Avant de refaire la console Instar, l’auteur a utilisé ChatGPT Dots, Meta Muse et Grok Bot sur de vrais comptes, pris 98 captures et classé chaque fonction : adopter, adapter ou rejeter. Les trois affichent toujours ensemble ce que l’agent a fait et ce qu’il avait le droit de faire. La meilleure idée est le « Take over / I’m done » de Grok : face à une connexion ou un consentement, il confie sa session en direct à l’humain puis reprend.

es.title: Lo que Dots, Muse y Grok Bot enseñan sobre interfaces de agentes
es.summary: Antes de rehacer la consola de Instar, el autor usó ChatGPT Dots, Meta Muse y Grok Bot con cuentas reales, tomó 98 capturas y calificó cada función como adoptar, adaptar o rechazar. Los tres muestran siempre juntos lo que hizo el agente y lo que tenía permitido. La mejor idea es el "Take over / I’m done" de Grok: ante un inicio de sesión o un consentimiento, cede su sesión en vivo a la persona y luego continúa.

de.title: Was Dots, Muse und Grok Bot über Agenten-Oberflächen lehren
de.summary: Vor dem Umbau der Instar-Konsole nutzte der Autor ChatGPT Dots, Meta Muse und Grok Bot mit echten Konten, machte 98 Screenshots und bewertete jede Funktion mit übernehmen, anpassen oder ablehnen. Alle drei zeigen stets zusammen, was der Agent tat und tun durfte. Die beste Idee ist Groks „Take over / I’m done“: An einer Login- oder Zustimmungshürde übergibt er die laufende Sitzung an den Menschen und macht danach weiter.

Art direction by Grok Bot; implementation by Codex (gpt-6.1-sol, high). **Awaiting owner director review — do not merge.**

- Oblique night city: extruded silhouette blocks with top/front faces and cast shadows, sparse lit windows (fixed cosmetic seed, not gameplay RNG), wet streets with sodium pools, fog at the edges, one landmark silhouette per district, street-sign district names.

- Static layers cached offscreen.
- Director round 1 applied: depth inverted on title, grey vignette, hollow water towers, flat boxes, small figures, thin cranes.

**Verification:** Node 22: lint pass; test:coverage 323 pass (sim.js 100% lines, golden hashes unchanged); test:e2e 68 pass incl. 10 canvas-coordinate lead clicks → 10 dispatches, no unit_*.png requests, reduced-motion static title; SwiftShader 1080p frame p95 < 20 ms, render p95 < 8 ms.

fr.summary: Dans cette PR de jeu, la direction artistique est assurée par Grok Bot et l’implémentation par Codex : ville nocturne en silhouettes vue en oblique, rues mouillées sous lampes au sodium et brouillard, personnages en fedora et trench générés procéduralement, skyline de titre en parallaxe à trois couches, statique en mouvement réduit. items.author: ESCAP0
items.text:
Redesign AgentRags: editorial paper, story pages, own images, data contract
Rebuilds AgentRags as an evening paper and makes it safe for Grokbot to run every night.

**Design**
- New masthead, type (Newsreader + Inter Tight, self-hosted), lead + grid layout, feeds band, earlier editions, credits this week. Mobile pass; no external requests.
- Lead is the story the curator's headline is about. Stories still trending from earlier nights count toward later editions.

**Pages**
- `/story/<id>/`: one permanent page per pick with sources, why it matters, tags, related stories. Feeds and the newsletter draft link here.

**Images**
- No hotlinked X or publisher media. Grokbot's illustrations (`static/img/posts/<id>.webp`) when present, generated two-ink cover art otherwise.
- `/api/needs-images.json` is Grokbot's work list; `IMAGES.md` is the spec.

**Grokbot contract**
- `scripts/check_data.py` runs before every build (Vercel, CI, nightly sync) and fails on malformed data, so the last good deploy stays live.
- `GROKBOT.md`: who may change what. The nightly sync no longer runs `card_images.py` / `fetch_x_posts.py` (removed); it runs `check_data.py` instead.

**Checked:** 205 pages, 0 broken internal links, 16 feeds valid, no console errors, no horizontal overflow at 1440 px or 390 px.

Merging deploys to production.

---
